page_title: Wavegrain - Curated TikTok slideshows and carousels on autopilot

sources.entry: Wavegrain - Curated slideshows and carousels for your brand on autopilot: writes TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels in your brand's voice, then schedules and posts them; hosted MCP server for AI agents. #social-media #mcp

summary.name: Wavegrain
summary.one_liner: Wavegrain is a tool that writes, designs, and schedules TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels for a brand, driven either from its web app or from an AI agent over a hosted MCP server.
use_cases: Turn a website into a month of TikTok slideshows
Repurpose proven viral formats around your product
Batch-create Instagram carousels for several brands
Drive social content creation from an AI agent
Plan and schedule posts across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Threads, Facebook and LinkedIn
summary.what_it_does: Wavegrain reads a website to pick up tone, niche and colours, then matches proven viral post structures (listicle, educational, story, before/after, quote, ranking, CTA) to the brand and generates slides, hooks, captions and images. Output can be edited in a slide editor, placed on a monthly calendar, and exported as 4:5, 1:1 or 9:16 slides in a ZIP or as a 9:16 MP4. Each approved batch gets a per-network caption and size before scheduling. The page says a hosted MCP server lets AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor drive the workflow, and states that nothing posts until the user approves it.
platforms: MCP clients (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Zed)
notable: Hosted MCP server so AI agents can create and schedule slideshows
Viral link analyzer that rebuilds a viral post's structure around your product
Nothing posts until the user approves the batch
Supports English, German, Spanish and other languages for generated copy
caveats: Paid subscriptions only on the page: Starter $29/month, Pro $49/month, Agency $99/month, billed monthly
Usage is limited by monthly content batches and credits per plan
Page lists a 'when is Wavegrain NOT the right tool' FAQ whose answer is not included in the extracted text
